description: Locks a TRON Energy rental price for 10 minutes, payable in USDC on Base (or Solana) through x402. No account or API key. Energy is delegated to target_address, which must be the wallet that will SEND the USDT. Creating a quote costs nothing.

duration_seconds.description: Rental length in seconds: 3600 (1 hour) or 86400 (1 day).

energy_amount.description: Energy to rent. 65,000 fits a USDT transfer to a wallet that already holds USDT; use 130,000 for a wallet with no USDT.

target_address.description: TRON wallet that will send the USDT and should receive the Energy.

name: create_x402_quote
title: Quote a TRON Energy rental payable with x402
